newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Jochimsen-EMU delay better than hasty start.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Jochimsen-EMU delay better than hasty start.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Reimut Jochimsen said on Wednesday that a hasty start for Europe's monetary union could be more damaging than a limited delay.
"A hasty entry into EMU would create a greater damage than a limited delay," Jochimsen said according to the text of a speech he is to deliver at the inauguration of a building here.
Jochimsen, who is also the president of the state central bank of North Rhine-Westphalia, said that if the currency union should be a success then nations would need to first do their homework.
Remaining structural weaknesses would be ruthlessly underscored by a currency union, Jochimsen said.
